questions.text: This paper consists of sections A, B and C with a total of ten (10) questions.
Answer all questions.
All answers must be written in the spaces provided
All writing must be in blue or black ink except drawings which must be in pencil.
All communication devices, calculators and any unauthorized materials are not allowed in the examination room.
Write your Examination Number at the top right hand corner of every page.

Acceleration due to gravity, 3 g = 10 m / s 2 . 3 (ii) Density of water = 1 g / cm or 1000 kg / m .
